title: Supercritical catalytic cracking of n-decane over microwave-synthesized hierarchical core–shell nano-Beta@SBA-15 composite zeolite
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13559-13571
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10130A, Paper
Open Access

Hailong Ma, Hui Gao, Jieyin Ma, Jiajun Zhao, Chen Zhang, Dongsheng Wen
Microwave-synthesized core–shell nano-Beta@SBA-15 zeolite achieves 14.9% higher activity and 39.7% less coke formation, with only 25.4% conversion loss over 15 hours in supercritical n-decane cracking.
